hive.title: Jev
hive.description: Typed yes/no, choice and score decisions from TypeSafe's Jev model. Suggests the right moment to compact the context (task boundaries, cold prompt cache) and gives the agent an ask_jev tool. Paste your TypeSafe API key in Settings → AI Providers.
